sections.label: Supply Bill appropriations approval
sections.summary: The Supply Bill seeks legislative approval for appropriations from the Consolidated Fund and Development Fund for the 2019-2020 Financial Year.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The purpose of the Supply Bill before Members is to give legislative approval for the appropriations from the Consolidated Fund and Development Fund to meet the expenditure for the Financial Year, 1 April 2019 to 31 March 2020.

sections.label: Minister expenditure warrants authorisation
sections.summary: Approval of the Supply Bill will empower the Minister to issue warrants authorising expenditure up to each Head's amount from the Consolidated Fund and Development Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Supply Bill, when approved, will empower the Minister to issue warrants authorising expenditure up to the amount for each Head as shown in the Bill to be paid out from the Consolidated Fund and Development Fund.
